subject.title: feat(ui): approval UX overhaul — inline cards, fair queue, shortcuts, badges

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this expanded approval-control workflow—including inline chat decisions, queue selection, badges, and global modifier shortcuts—as the supported Control UI direction?
rationale: This is a substantial new UX and operator-safety interaction model, not an established behavior contract that can be accepted solely from unit coverage.

options.title: Sponsor the approval UX
options.body: Accept the product direction after reviewing a redacted live UI proof and completing normal code review.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Retain a smaller approved subset, such as fair queue ordering and visible expiry, while deferring inline cards or global shortcuts.

options.title: Pause for design direction
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define the intended approval interaction and shortcut policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the approval UX
recommendation.body: Accept the product direction after reviewing a redacted live UI proof and completing normal code review.
